# Eagle View Futures

> Psychology-driven futures trading mentorship. Master Volume Profile, market structure, and trader psychology with live coaching and a private Discord community.

Eagle View Futures teaches a complete futures trading system built around Volume Profile mastery, market structure, and the mental frameworks required to execute consistently on NQ and ES. The program includes a structured curriculum, live walkthroughs, a private Discord, and direct coaching access.
